acceptance_criteria: Write a UTF-8 JSON object with exactly round, verdict, summary, findings and verified. Set round to integer 2 and verdict to revise or approve.

Account for both prior finding IDs. Each resolved finding has a verified entry with id and evidence citing specific passages in both old and current files and describing the operational change. Each unresolved finding retains its original ID and identifies the remaining gap.

Summarize current validation and independently check all six activities in brief order with continuous 16:00–19:00 local coverage, agreement between logistics JSON and Markdown, at most six volunteers, accessibility arrangements and contingency triggers, actions and owners.

Recompute catalog pack coverage, line costs, subtotal, reserve and total. Reconcile unique SKUs, counts and supply assumptions with current logistics. Check at least 50 food servings, 50 drink servings and 50 name tags, at least 3000 cents of reserve and a total of at most 30000 cents. Verify shortage ownership, whole-pack rounding, catalog costs and the minimum reserve after replenishment.

Verify that the Instagram caption, flyer and promotional email each stand alone and match the brief and current logistics on event name, February 19, 2027, 16:00–19:00 local time, audience, all six activities and supported attendee promises. Check placeholders for venue, RSVP, accessibility contact and any speaker names mentioned.

Each unresolved or new material finding has a stable unique id, a specialist role, evidence naming a current file and passage or omission, impact and an actionable request. Apply all approval gates and keep the run unapproved if no substantive round-one improvement can be verified.
